## Art. 12 | Record-keeping
High-risk systems shall allow automatic recording of events.

### 1
Systems shall technically allow for the automatic recording of events (logs) over the whole lifetime.

### 2
Logging capabilities shall enable traceability.

## Annex III | High-risk AI systems
### 4
Employment, workers management.

### 4(a)
AI systems intended to be used for recruitment.

## Art. 50 | Transparency
### 1
Users shall be informed that they interact with an AI system.
